video_title: Keaton Wagler Press Conference | LA Clippers Media Day 2026

quotes.speaker: Keaton Wagler
quotes.summary_phrase: Keaton Wagler is focusing on defensive schemes and adapting to a new pick and roll offense.
quotes.quote: I think the main thing first is just the defensive side of the ball, just wanting to get better there and learning our scheme and coverages and all that. But offensively, I worked a lot in the pick and roll game and just working with our different bigs that we have versus, you know, at Illinois I had popping bigs, but now it's different here and just like the way that our offense flows.
quotes.social_post: Keaton Wagler says he is prioritizing his defensive growth and adjusting to the Clippers offensive scheme during his first offseason.

quotes.speaker: Keaton Wagler
quotes.summary_phrase: Keaton Wagler has gained weight and muscle through a dedicated summer lifting program.
quotes.quote: I've put on some more weight and muscle too. So that's kind of been a big thing for me is, you know, I was lifting super hard throughout the summer. They have me on a great plan, getting in here four times a week, getting lifts in to to get stronger and be prepared for this season. So I feel like I've done a really good job there.
quotes.social_post: Keaton Wagler says he has been hitting the weight room hard this summer to get stronger and prepare his body for his first NBA season.

quotes.speaker: Keaton Wagler
quotes.summary_phrase: Keaton Wagler is focused on maintaining a strong mental approach to handle rookie pressure.
quotes.quote: I'm just going to do my best to stay mentally focused, not worried about all the outside noise or whatever that comes along with it. Obviously, there's pressure, you know, you're going to be nervous for the games that are coming up, it's your first time in the NBA, so going in there with the right mindset, I think, not worrying about good or bad games but just continuing to get better each day.
quotes.social_post: Keaton Wagler says he is focused on staying mentally locked in and not worrying about the outside noise as he prepares for his first NBA season.

quotes.speaker: Keaton Wagler
quotes.summary_phrase: Keaton Wagler expects to play multiple roles and handle the ball alongside teammates.
quotes.quote: It'll definitely be a lot of fun. Kind of in pickup, we kind of have that already going on where I'll be ball handler, but then someone else will get it and so I'll run and be a second action guy. So I think it'll all just become a lot easier as I get more comfortable, but I'm excited to be able to do that and be able to play alongside DG who's going to have the ball in his hands a lot.
quotes.social_post: Keaton Wagler says he is looking forward to playing multiple roles and learning to play off the ball alongside his teammates.
